nodes.long_description: In this activity, participants select a picture they like and work on completing it as a puzzle. This process encourages problem-solving skills, concentration, and patience, as they piece together each part to reveal the complete image. It’s a fun and engaging way to exercise the mind and improve spatial awareness.
